titleEn: What Needs to Be Done Now
summary: Eren cannot transform on command. The 104th cadets choose a regiment, and Jean's memory of Marco pulls him toward the Survey Corps.

segments.titleEn: A morning when he cannot transform
segments.ja: 実験の朝、エレンは命じられたとおり手を切りました。血は出ます。巨人にはなりません。特別作戦班の半円が、ほんの少し刃を上げます。ハンジは失敗を怒りません。条件が足りない、とメモします。痛みだけでは体は動かない。目的が要るのか、怒りの形が要るのか、まだ分かりません。エレンは自分の無力を、鎖より恥ずかしく感じました。リヴァイは結果を見て、今日は殺せない、と短く言います。殺せないのは、巨人にならなかったからです。
segments.en: On the morning of the experiment Eren cut his hand, as ordered. There was blood. There was no Titan. The half circle of the Special Operations Squad lifted its blades a little. Hange was not angry at the failure. Not enough conditions, they wrote. Pain alone did not move the body. Maybe a purpose was required. Maybe a particular shape of anger. They did not know yet. Eren felt his uselessness as something more shameful than chains. Levi looked at the result and said, briefly, that he could not kill him today. He could not kill him because Eren had not become a Titan.

segments.ja: ハンジは失敗を、次の実験の材料に変えます。トロストで意識が戻ったとき、エレンには守る相手と、明確な任務がありました。城の庭には、そのどちらもありません。だから体は巨人を作らない。仮説はまだ証明ではありません。それでも班の空気が少し緩みます。今この瞬間のエレンは、討伐対象ではなく、仮説の協力者です。ペトラは茶を渡し、オルオは相変わらず大きな声で自分の心得を語ります。普通の朝が、実験の失敗の上に戻りました。
segments.en: Hange turned the failure into material for the next experiment. When Eren's mind returned at Trost, he had someone to protect and a clear mission. The castle yard had neither. So the body did not build a Titan. A hypothesis is not yet proof. The squad's air loosened a little anyway. In this moment Eren was not a target to be slain. He was a partner in a hypothesis. Petra handed him tea. Oluo, as usual, explained his own wisdom too loudly. An ordinary morning came back, standing on top of a failed experiment.

segments.ja: 同じ日、訓練を終えた同期たちには別の任務がありました。所属を決めることです。駐屯兵団、憲兵団、調査兵団。壁を守るか、内側の秩序に入るか、外へ出るか。会場の空気は、勧誘というより別れの準備に近いものでした。多くの新兵は、生きて帰れる道を目で探します。調査兵団の翼は美しいまま、死亡率の話と一緒に壁に貼られていました。
segments.en: On the same day, the classmates who had finished training had a different mission. They had to choose a regiment. Garrison, Military Police, Survey Corps. Defend the walls, enter the order inside them, or go outside. The air in the hall was closer to preparing for goodbyes than to a recruitment fair. Many recruits searched with their eyes for the road that came back alive. The Survey Corps wings stayed beautiful on the wall, posted beside the talk of how many people died.

segments.ja: ジャンは憲兵団の楽な席を、長いあいだ自分の正解だと思っていました。壁の内側、巨人の少ない場所、顔の広い仕事。マルコがいない今、その正解は急に薄くなります。マルコなら何を選ぶか、ではなく、マルコが自分に何を期待していたか。ジャンはその期待を、立派な言葉としては思い出せません。ただ、弱い自分を隠さなくていい、という感じだけが残っています。その感じは、憲兵団の安全とうまく重なりません。
segments.en: For a long time Jean had thought a comfortable seat in the Military Police was his correct answer. Inside the walls. Fewer Titans. Work with a broad face. Now that Marco was gone, that correct answer had become thin. Not what Marco would have chosen. What Marco had expected of him. Jean could not remember that expectation as a fine speech. Only a feeling remained: that he did not have to hide the weak part of himself. That feeling did not sit well on top of the Military Police's safety.

Erwin did not tell that story in a loud voice. Among the people choosing the wings, Shiganshina still moved as the name of a destination. segments.en: The cadets' choice reached the castle of the Special Operations Squad. Eren heard that his classmates had taken the wings, and joy arrived together with guilt. The fear that they were coming to die for him. Levi did not treat that fear as special. People who joined the Survey Corps had chosen work that was already likely to kill them. Do not make it only your fault. The sentence was short. Eren could not take it as comfort. As a fact, it made breathing a little easier.

segments.ja: 変身の失敗は、一度では終わりません。ハンジは傷の深さ、言葉の内容、周囲の人数を変えて試します。どれも巨人を呼びません。班の刃は試行のたびに少し上がり、下がります。エレンは自分が欠陥品に戻った気がして、アルミンの仮説を汚したように感じます。ハンジは逆です。呼ばない条件が分かれば、呼ぶ条件に近づく。失敗の回数を、その人は前進として数えます。エレンは数え方を真似できませんが、刃が下がる瞬間だけは助かりました。
segments.en: The failed transformation did not end with one try. Hange changed the depth of the cut, the content of the words, and the number of people nearby. None of it called a Titan. The squad's blades rose a little with each attempt and then lowered. Eren felt he had gone back to being a defective thing, and that he had dirtied Armin's hypothesis. Hange was the opposite. If you learn the conditions that do not call it, you move closer to the conditions that do. That person counted the number of failures as progress. Eren could not copy the counting. He was saved only by the moment the blades went down.

segments.ja: 所属を決める会場には、三つの旗が同じ高さで立っています。駐屯、憲兵、調査。調査兵団の旗だけ、縁がすり切れています。新兵はそのすり切れを、名誉とも消耗とも読めます。演説は長くありません。外に出れば死ぬ確率が高い。それでも壁の外の無知を減らす人間が要る。それだけです。ジャンはその短さを、騙しではない証拠として聞きます。騙すなら、もっと美しい言葉を使ったはずだ、と。美しい言葉がないことが、逆に彼の足を翼のほうへ寄せました。
segments.en: In the hall where regiments were chosen, three flags stood at the same height. Garrison, Military Police, Survey Corps. Only the Survey Corps flag was frayed at the edge. A recruit could read that fraying as honor or as wear. The speech was not long. If you go outside, the chance of death is high. Even so, someone has to reduce humanity's ignorance beyond the walls. That was all. Jean heard the shortness as evidence that he was not being tricked. If they meant to trick him, they would have used prettier words. The absence of pretty words pushed his feet, instead, toward the wings.

segments.ja: 翼を選んだ同期は、その夜に立体機動装置の点検をします。サシャはベルトの穴を一度外し、コニーは刃の数を二度数えます。ミカサは手早く終わらせ、アルミンは索敵陣形の図を膝の上でなぞります。ジャンは装置の金具を磨きながら、憲兵団の楽な椅子を思い浮かべ、すぐに消します。マルコが見たら何と言うかは、もう想像しません。想像の代わりに、金具が緩んでいないことだけを確認します。遠征は、感情が終わった場所から装備の仕事として始まっていました。
segments.en: The classmates who had chosen the wings spent that night checking ODM gear. Sasha undid a belt hole once. Connie counted blades twice. Mikasa finished quickly. Armin traced the scouting formation on his knee. Jean polished a buckle, pictured a comfortable Military Police chair, and erased it. He no longer imagined what Marco would have said. Instead of imagining, he checked only that the buckle was not loose. The expedition had begun, from the place where feeling ended, as the work of equipment.

segments.en: At the castle Eren could not become a Titan, and at the hall his classmates took the wings. The two facts sat on the same date and were not yet tied into one line. Levi received the list of recruits and made no special reaction. Hange put the experiment notes ahead of the list. Only Eren set a face on each name. Jean, Sasha, Connie, Mikasa, Armin. Each time he set a face down, the danger of the expedition changed from a number into a person. Danger that had become a person was heavier than a hypothesis.

vocab.exampleEn: On the morning of the experiment Eren cut his hand, as ordered. There was blood. There was no Titan. The half circle of the Special Operations Squad lifted its blades a little. Hange was not angry at the failure. Not enough conditions, they wrote. Pain alone did not move the body. Maybe a purpose was required. Maybe a particular shape of anger. They did not know yet. Eren felt his uselessness as something more shameful than chains. Levi looked at the result and said, briefly, that he could not kill him today. He could not kill him because Eren had not become a Titan.
